messages:
Mia: FYI NovaGPU just updated lead times for H200 shipments into EU. New ETA 6-8 weeks for reserved pool. Need quick call on allocation vs using RMA replacements.
Ajay: Oof. That timeline hits our q2 commit. What's current reserved count for eu-west?
Luke: eu-west-1 reserved capacity: 420 H200s total, 356 allocated (85%). Burst pool ~24 available, but those are already earmarked for latency SLAs.
Sofia: If we shift some workloads to h100+quantized variants we can free ~40 slots, but perf/regression risk. Any chance vendor can expedite partial shipments?
Evelyn (NovaGPU): Evelyn (NovaGPU) here — we can do a split shipment: 50% by sea (6–8w) + 20 units air-expedite in 2–3w, but air incurs a one-off expedite surcharge and requires advanced customs docs. I can share rates.
Mia: Send numbers. Need cost delta vs accepting vendor RMAs (refurb) that are available now. Any RMA batches we can use short-term?
Evelyn (NovaGPU): We have 30 certified RMA units in NL depot ready for cross-dock. They are tested, warranty-complete; discount ~18% vs new, but ETA 3–5 days for handoff.
Ajay: Important: RMAs cannot be used for HIPAA customers — compliance flag. Which customers are flagged?
Luke: HIPAA/regulated tenants: 7 clusters pinned to dedicated pools (customers A, B, C). Those cannot take refurbished devices. Others (dev, research, analytics) can.
Sofia: Proposal: Use 30 RMA units to cover non-regulated burst workloads immediately; for regulated workloads, accept 20 air-expedite H200s and backfill remaining with sea. Approve if cost differential is within budget.
Mia: Rough numbers? Put them in one line so finance can triage.
Evelyn (NovaGPU): Rate summary: 
```
new H200 (sea): $23,800/unit, ETA 6-8w
new H200 (air-expedite): $29,500/unit, ETA 2-3w (includes expedite fee + carrier)
RMA H200 (refurb, NL depot): $19,520/unit, ETA 3-5 days, 12-mo warranty
Customs + import VAT estimate (EU): ~€1,200/unit (sea), ~€1,850/unit (air)
```
Luke: Quick calc: if we take 20 air units to cover regulated pools: delta vs sea per unit ~= $5,700 + ~€650 VAT diff => ~+$6.3k/unit landed. Total incremental ~ $126k. RMA route saves ~ $4.3k/unit vs new sea landed.
Ajay: Ops risk: RMAs have higher DOA rate historically (1.8% vs 0.9% for new). With 30 RMAs expect ~0.5–1 unit re-replace overhead. That's fine operationally.
Mia: OK, what's the approval ask? Can procurement sign off on 20 air units + accept 30 RMAs for non-regulated pools? Need PO wording for partial shipments and RMA acceptance criteria.
Evelyn (NovaGPU): We can accept POs that allow split shipments and list serials for RMA batch. PO should include: "split shipment allowed, air-expedite for first 20 H200s, remainder by sea; RMA units acceptable for non-regulated SKUs; 30 RMAs reserved under holding ID NOVA-RMA-0911."
Sofia: Also ensure clause: vendor to replace DOA RMA within 72h or provide loaner pool.
VendorOpsBot: [vendor-ops] created RMA hold NOVA-RMA-0911, reserved 30 units, expected release window 3 business days.
Luke: Logistics note — cross-dock from NL to FRA hub then DDP EU distribution. Need customs docs from vendor 48h pre-move. Evelyn can you confirm EORI and commercial invoice format?
Evelyn (NovaGPU): Confirmed. I'll upload commercial invoice + EORI under the PO ticket by EOD. Will also include batch serial manifest.
Ajay: Cost center allocation: split expedite cost to product team alpha (70%) and infra contingency (30%). Finance ok with that?
Mia: Finance approve up to $150k incremental expedite spend on this path; anything above needs CFO sign-off.
Sofia: Action items: (1) Procurement to issue PO with split-shipment + RMA clause, (2) Evelyn to upload invoices & serial manifest, (3) Infra to tag non-regulated pools for RMA placement, (4) Ops to monitor DOA metrics daily for 7 days post-handoff.
Mia: I'll draft the PO text. Callout for compliance: regulated clusters cannot accept RMA — double-check tenant mapping in console before labeling.
Luke: I'll create a quick runbook for RMA onboarding (sanity checks, firmware reconcile, KV cache wipe).
Evelyn (NovaGPU): Will hold air capacity for 48h pending PO. Please confirm by 1600 UTC.
Mia: Confirmed. Proceed with PO draft and tagging. Thanks — will update thread after PO issued. :thumbsup:
